node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-corner-equivalence to the one-dimensional t-projections (P_j) (the t-projection property follows from P_j=w(e_j), e_j^2=e_j, and the t-multiplicative-defect clause of the extended t-inclusion). Thus j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 is an equivalence relation. A corner between one-dimensional projections has dimension at most one; hence its dimension is 0 or 1. Since U and V are unions of equivalence classes sharing no class, every j in U and k in V is unrelated, so dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=dim S^A_{P_k,P_j}=0.
